rows.what_the_ink_shows: Serre has two distinct gray underlines and is crossed by the dark cancellation stroke. After the word there is one clearly detached lower dot. Directly above it the cancellation stroke has a small thickened area, but an independent upper dot cannot be separated securely from that stroke. The lower dot supports punctuation; the overlapped upper position leaves period versus colon unresolved.
